'''Pfistak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] who served [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Dixton]] of the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]].<ref name="Godking" /> Not trusting in the abilities of standard Imperial bodyguards, Dixton hired Pfistak to personally guard him.<ref name="Godking-CC">{{WEGCite|book=Classic Campaigns|story=Tests of the Godking}}</ref>
